title: Structured flow categories and twisted presheaves
summary: An orientation theory for flow categories without bubbling is determined by a functor of $\infty$-categories $μ\colon \mathcal{C} \to U/O$. For any such functor, we construct a stable $\infty$-category $\mathcal{F}low^μ$ of $μ$-structured flow categories and bimodules. We also construct the expected functors between such $\infty$-categories, giving a tractable framework for manipulating orientations, local systems, and filtrations in exact Floer homotopy theory.
